يعتلين (form VIII)
# يَعْتَلِينَ (yaʕtalīna) /jaʕ.ta.liː.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَلَى (iʕtalā)
# يُعْتَلَيْنَ (yuʕtalayna) /juʕ.ta.laj.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَلَى (iʕtalā)
